summary.headline: Carysil Q4 FY26 consolidated total income rose 16% to INR237 crores and PAT (after MI) jumped 42% to INR27 crores, with EBITDA margin at 20.3%.
summary.overview: Carysil reported Q4 FY26 consolidated total income of INR237 crores (up 16% YoY), EBITDA of INR48 crores (up 33%, margin 20.3%, up 277 bps) and PAT after MI of INR27 crores (up 42%). For FY26, total income rose 14% to INR932 crores, EBITDA grew 30% to INR185 crores (margin 19.9% vs 17.3%) and PAT after MI rose 53% to INR98 crores. Management framed FY27 as a year of capacity expansion and execution, with a 250,000-unit quartz sink line due in Q4 FY27 and 70,000 units of stainless steel capacity commissioned on the call date. The company guided to 15-20% revenue growth and 18-20% EBITDA margin, while flagging freight, gas and MMA cost pressures.

financial_highlights.metric: Cash and bank balance as on 31 March 2026

segments.name: Quartz Sink
segments.commentary: Q4 FY26 volume 195.5K units; FY26 volumes grew about 21%, supported by exports and improving domestic traction. Capacity to rise by 250,000 units to 1,250,000 units, targeted for Q4 FY27.

segments.name: Stainless Steel Sink
segments.commentary: Q4 FY26 volume 44.6K units; value grew about 20% in FY26. Subsidiary Carysilnox added 70,000 units/year, taking capacity from 180,000 to 250,000 units; management expects it to be fully mature within about 90 days.

segments.name: Kitchen appliances and others
segments.commentary: Q4 FY26 volume 8.5K units. Pilot hood and hob production underway; a new plant is planned for 100,000 units in two 50,000-unit phases, with phase 1 in FY28 and infra cost of INR30-40 crores.

segments.name: Faucets
segments.commentary: Q4 FY26 sales volume 10.2K units. Stainless steel and brass faucets now in production, with a faucet capacity of about 50,000 units; management cites 50-60% gross margins for hoods and faucets, targeting about 60% with new products.

segments.name: Surfaces (solid surface, UK/US)
segments.commentary: US sales grew about 10%. FY27 AOP assumes about 10% growth, with management expecting 7-8% on surfaces. UK is described as bottomed out with about 15 new customers added in three quarters; UK manufacturing is dedicated to UK-only and consists of solid surface.

segments.name: India business and online
segments.commentary: Online contributed about INR5 crores in FY26 and is expected to rise 2-3x this year after listing on a large e-commerce marketplace. India revenue is about INR175 crores; the target is INR500 crores in under 5 years, which requires 30-40% annual growth.

segments.name: International subsidiaries
segments.commentary: Carysil Corporation USA reached operational breakeven in FY26. FZ LLC (UAE) reported healthy demand, and a second UAE brand store is opening shortly.

guidance_outlook: Revenue growth guidance of 15-20% retained for the coming year, though management declined to commit beyond it given geopolitical risks.
EBITDA margin guidance of 18-20% maintained; management said upside is possible if the geopolitical situation normalises.
Marketing and development spend benchmarked at about 10% of sales, with exhibition costs treated as one-offs.
Surface business expected to grow about 7-8% against a 10% AOP budget.
FY27 capex plan of INR70-75 crores; capex beyond FY27 to be decided after a review in Q2.
Long-term aspiration of a $1 billion kitchen business; India target of INR500 crores in under 5 years.
capex_capacity: Quartz sink capacity +250,000 units to 1,250,000 units, expected operational in Q4 FY27; management said utilisation could be reached within 6 months to a year.

Stainless steel: Carysilnox commenced 70,000 units/year additional capacity on 21 May 2026, taking total to 250,000 units; additional adjacent land acquired for future expansion; OEM backlogs at Grohe, Kohler and Hafele.
Appliances: new plant for 100,000 units in two 50,000-unit phases; phase 1 in FY28; collaboration with a large international partner under discussion; infra and assembly line cost INR30-40 crores.
FY26 capex was INR68 crores; FY27 capex plan is INR70-75 crores.
demand_pricing: Freight and container delays are affecting export shipments to the US, UK and UAE; management said the company is managing them but they are outside its control.
Gas supply was disrupted for a few weeks; supply is now 100%.
MMA prices rose about 25-35% over the last two months, with the increase now reported to have stopped; management said these costs have largely been passed through to customers.
Europe: order inflow has picked up as European competitors weaken; the company is present in 12 European countries and has hired a business development manager in Germany.
Rupee depreciation of about 5-6% contributed to sales; management attributed about INR2.5 crores of Q4 forex gain to it.

qa_highlights.question: Is the 5-year INR500 crore India target conservative?
qa_highlights.answer: Management called it conservative but realistic and said it implies 30-40% annual growth; it is a launch phase and momentum is expected to build after 1-2 years.

qa_highlights.question: Why did stainless steel volumes grow about 50% YoY?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited high-end product launches, stronger Indian demand and new OEM supply to Hafele and Kohler, which drove the capacity expansion.

qa_highlights.question: What are the margins for kitchen hoods and faucets?
qa_highlights.answer: Gross margins are about 50-60% currently, with the company targeting about 60% as new products come in; India margins are below export levels due to launch-phase marketing and team costs.

qa_highlights.question: When will the quartz capacity come on stream and what is its utilisation?
qa_highlights.answer: Expected in Q4 FY27 after ground work started; the 250,000-unit addition lifts capacity to 1,250,000 units.

qa_highlights.question: Can revenue growth exceed 20% with new capacity?
qa_highlights.answer: Management declined to go beyond the 15-20% growth guidance, citing geopolitical uncertainty, and reiterated the 18-20% margin guidance.

qa_highlights.question: What is the next-year capex plan?
qa_highlights.answer: FY27 capex is INR70-75 crores; capex beyond FY27 will be decided after a review in Q2.

risks_watch: Freight and container delays, plus geopolitical trade disruption, affecting export timelines and visibility.
MMA and other raw material price swings; management says prices have stopped rising but the pass-through is not guaranteed.
Execution risk on the 250,000-unit quartz sink line (Q4 FY27), the stainless steel ramp-up within 90 days, and the appliance plant (FY28).
UK market recovery remains unproven; management says it has bottomed, but surfaces growth guidance is only 7-8%.
India ambition requires 30-40% growth; India margins are below export levels during the launch phase.
Net debt of about INR211 crores (gross debt INR270 crores less cash INR59 crores) against FY27 capex of INR70-75 crores.
summary.management_tone: Confident on the operating outlook and volume momentum, with a clear focus on execution and capacity. Cautious and noncommittal on forward growth, declining to go beyond the 15-20% revenue guidance and citing geopolitical and freight uncertainty. Some answers were loose or hard to follow, particularly on capacity figures and the quartz commissioning date, which the chairman corrected during the call.
